entry.title: Hackers heat French supermarket fridges, sparking fires and spoiling food
entry.summary: Major French supermarket chains on Monday said they were hit by a cyberattack that caused their refrigerators to shoot up in temperature in hundreds of stores, forcing spoiled food to be thrown away and raising concerns about food security.
entry.content:
